NARA directly identifies Max Shoop as OSS reference 284. Scholarly history and contemporary firm evidence document his Sullivan & Cromwell role before wartime intelligence work. A Red Cross cover or intervening wartime role prevents labeling the firm immediate pre-OSS.

claims.claim_text: Max Shoop's last documented civilian employer before wartime intelligence work was Sullivan & Cromwell, where he practiced law and headed the Paris office.

claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed OSS identity; high-confidence employer match from the distinctive name and independent firm evidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly bounded as the last documented civilian employer before wartime service; an intervening Red Cross cover prevents an immediate-pre-OSS label.
claims.match_notes: The historical firm name is preserved and the claim is not expanded into an unsupported exact recruitment date.
